"""Paired map memory diagnostic for waterui PR #3401 (issue #3397).

usage: run_3397_ab_v2.py <arm> <apk> <census.patch> [revision]

       against the candidate census worktree. One output directory per arm name.

Captures dumpsys meminfo and a screenshot after warm-up (initial), after the
stepped pan (panned), after a settle (settled) and, after
`am send-trim-memory RUNNING_CRITICAL` plus a further settle (trimmed). Each
capture also records the last census log lines streamed from the app.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,re,subprocess,time,sys,signal,select
state=Path(__file__).parent
BASELINE=Path('/Users/lexoliu/Coding/waterui-worktrees/3397-baseline')
CANDIDATE=Path('/Users/lexoliu/Coding/waterui-worktrees/3397-census-head')
arm=sys.argv[1]
root=BASELINE if arm.startswith('base') else CANDIDATE
out=state/('3397-mem-v2-'+arm);out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
apk=Path(sys.argv[2]);patch=Path(sys.argv[3])
serial='pixel-9-pro:5555';pkg='com.waterui.example.map'
SETTLE_SECONDS=10;TRIM_SETTLE_SECONDS=15
CAPTURES=['initial','panned','settled','trimmed']
repository=Path('/Users/lexoliu/Coding/cherenkov-benchmarks')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repository/'scripts'))
from sync_runs import RunArchive,publish
def adb(*args,timeout=30):
 return subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s',serial,*args],timeout=timeout)
def text(*args):return adb(*args).decode().strip()
CENSUS_MARKERS=['picture residency accounting census','completed picture allocator census']
captured_census={}
def last_census():
 found={}
 for marker in CENSUS_MARKERS:
  lines=[line for line in log if marker in line]
  found[marker]=lines[-1] if lines else None
 return found
def capture(name):
 (out/(name+'.png')).write_bytes(adb('exec-out','screencap','-p'))
 (out/(name+'-memory.txt')).write_bytes(adb('shell','dumpsys','meminfo',pkg))
 if pid:
  drain_lines();drain_lines()
 captured_census[name]=last_census()
 (out/(name+'-census.txt')).write_text('\n'.join(f'{marker}: {line}' for marker,line in captured_census[name].items()))
def terminate(*_):raise SystemExit('device deadline reached')
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,terminate)
metadata={'device':{'model':text('shell','getprop','ro.product.model'),'model_identifier':text('shell','getprop','ro.product.device'),'os':'Android '+text('shell','getprop','ro.build.version.release'),'gpu':'Mali-G715'},'source':{'revision':(sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv)>4 else subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True,timeout=10).strip())},'configuration':{'measurement_kind':'real-map-memory-diagnostic','comparison':'stepped-camera preparation diagnostic with process memory after pan, settle and a RUNNING_CRITICAL trim; compare only equivalent captures; not continuous-scroll p99','arm':arm,'warmup_seconds':30,'drag_pairs':2,'steps_per_drag':12,'step_completion':'wait for presented frame, then continue; hold before release to suppress fling','settle_seconds':SETTLE_SECONDS,'trim_settle_seconds':TRIM_SETTLE_SECONDS,'trim':'am send-trim-memory RUNNING_CRITICAL','instrumentation':'standard lower_ms logging; picture residency and allocator census logs; process memory only; no whole-frame/GPU/p99 claim'}}
journal=RunArchive(out/'journal',metadata)
backups=[]
for i,line in enumerate(text('shell','pm','path',pkg).splitlines()):
 p=out/f'previous-{i}.apk';adb('pull',line.removeprefix('package:'),str(p),timeout=60);backups.append(str(p))
previous_timeout=text('shell','settings','get','system','screen_off_timeout')
awake='mWakefulness=Awake' in text('shell','dumpsys','power')
logcat=None;pid=None;installed=False;completed=False;log=[];warmup_frames=0;measured=[];pending=b''
def drain_lines(wait_for_frame=False):
 global pending
 deadline=time.monotonic()+(15 if wait_for_frame else 0.1)
 presented=False;lowered=False
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  ready,_,_=select.select([logcat.stdout],[],[],0.1)
  if not ready:
   if not wait_for_frame or (presented and lowered):return
   continue
  chunk=os.read(logcat.stdout.fileno(),65536)
  if not chunk:raise RuntimeError('logcat ended during stepped pan')
  pending+=chunk
  while b'\n' in pending:
   line,pending=pending.split(b'\n',1);line=line.decode(errors='replace');log.append(line)
   if 'panic at ' in line or 'device lost' in line.lower():raise RuntimeError(line)
   if 'frame lowered surfaces=' in line:lowered=True
   if 'frame presented' in line:presented=True

 if wait_for_frame:raise TimeoutError('stepped pan frame not presented in 15 seconds')
def meminfo_rows(name):
 path=out/(name+'-memory.txt')
 if not path.exists():return None
 rows=[]
 for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
  if re.match(r'\s*(GL mtrack|EGL mtrack|Graphics|Native Heap|Private Other|TOTAL PSS|TOTAL\b|Total PSS)',line,re.I):rows.append(line.strip())
 return rows
def summary():
 lines=[f'=== arm {arm} ({root.name}) ===']
 for name in CAPTURES:
  rows=meminfo_rows(name)
  if rows is None:lines.append(f'[{name}] not captured');continue
  lines.append(f'[{name}] meminfo rows')
  lines+=['    '+row for row in rows]
  for marker,line in captured_census.get(name,{}).items():
   lines.append(f'    census {marker}: '+(line[:600] if line else 'none seen'))
 return '\n'.join(lines)

 adb('shell','settings','put','system','screen_off_timeout','300000')
 adb('shell','input','keyevent','KEYCODE_WAKEUP');adb('shell','wm','dismiss-keyguard')
 result=text('install','-r','-d',str(apk))
 if 'Success' not in result:raise RuntimeError(result)
 installed=True
 adb('shell','am','start','-W','-S','-n',pkg+'/.MainActivity','--es','waterui.log.level','DEBUG')
 pid=text('shell','pidof',pkg)
 logcat=subprocess.Popen(['adb','-s',serial,'logcat','-v','epoch','--pid='+pid],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+90;activated=False
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  ready,_,_=select.select([logcat.stdout],[],[],1)
  if not ready:continue
  chunk=os.read(logcat.stdout.fileno(),65536)
  if not chunk:raise RuntimeError('logcat ended before map readiness')
  pending+=chunk
  while b'\n' in pending:
   line,pending=pending.split(b'\n',1);line=line.decode(errors='replace');log.append(line)
   if 'panic at ' in line:raise RuntimeError(line)
   if 'activated prepared GPU map' in line:activated=True
   if activated and 'frame presented' in line:completed=True;break
  if completed:break
 if not completed:raise TimeoutError('map activation/presentation not observed in 90 seconds')
 time.sleep(30)
 drain_lines()
 warmup_frames=sum('frame lowered surfaces=' in line for line in log)
 capture('initial')
 completed=False
 steps=[]
 for cycle in range(2):
  for start,end in [(700,340),(340,700)]:
   adb('shell','input','motionevent','DOWN',str(start),'1100')
   time.sleep(0.3);drain_lines()
   for index in range(1,13):
    x=round(start+(end-start)*index/12)
    drain_lines()
    previous=len(log)
    adb('shell','input','motionevent','MOVE',str(x),'1100')
    drain_lines(True)
    steps.append({'cycle':cycle,'start':start,'step':index,'x':x,'log':log[previous:]})
   time.sleep(1)
   adb('shell','input','motionevent','UP',str(end),'1100')
   time.sleep(0.5);drain_lines()
 (out/'steps.json').write_text(json.dumps(steps,indent=2))
 capture('panned')
 time.sleep(SETTLE_SECONDS)
 capture('settled')
 if text('shell','pidof',pkg)!=pid:raise RuntimeError('app process changed before trim')
 adb('shell','am','send-trim-memory',pkg,'RUNNING_CRITICAL')
 time.sleep(TRIM_SETTLE_SECONDS)
 if text('shell','pidof',pkg)!=pid:raise RuntimeError('app process died after trim; the trimmed capture is not comparable')
 capture('trimmed')
 completed=True
 print('captured initial, panned, settled and trimmed map',flush=True)
finally:
 if logcat:
  try:drain_lines();drain_lines()
  except Exception as error:print('final log drain failed:',error,flush=True)
  logcat.terminate();logcat.wait(timeout=10)
 if pid:
  (out/'app-dump.log').write_bytes(adb('logcat','-d','-v','epoch','--pid='+pid))
 (out/'app.log').write_text('\n'.join(log))
 if installed:
  adb('shell','am','force-stop',pkg)
  if backups:adb('install' if len(backups)==1 else 'install-multiple','-r','-d',*backups,timeout=120)
 if previous_timeout=='null':adb('shell','settings','delete','system','screen_off_timeout')
 else:adb('shell','settings','put','system','screen_off_timeout',previous_timeout)
 if not awake:adb('shell','input','keyevent','KEYCODE_SLEEP')
 rows=[line for line in log if 'frame lowered surfaces=' in line]
 measured=[{'lower_ms':float(re.search(r'lower_ms=([0-9.eE+-]+)',line)[1]),'log':line} for line in rows[warmup_frames:]]
 (out/'preparation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'warmup_frames':warmup_frames,'samples':measured,'completed':completed},indent=2))
 report=out/'diagnostic.json'
 report.write_text(json.dumps({'engine':'cherenkov','scene':'real-map-load-pan','width':None,'height':None,'samples':[],'completed':completed,'log':log,'instrumentation_patch':patch.read_text()},indent=2))
 summary_text=summary();(out/'summary.txt').write_text(summary_text+'\n')
 print(summary_text,flush=True)
 chunks=[log[i:i+250] for i in range(0,len(log),250)] or [[]]
 for index,chunk in enumerate(chunks):
  part=out/f'diagnostic-part-{index+1}.json'
  data={'engine':'cherenkov','scene':'real-map-load-pan','width':None,'height':None,'samples':[],'completed':completed,'log':chunk,'diagnostic_part':index+1,'diagnostic_parts':len(chunks)}
  if index==0:
   data['stepped_preparation']=json.loads((out/'steps.json').read_text()) if (out/'steps.json').exists() else [];data['instrumentation_patch']=patch.read_text();data['preparation_samples']=measured;data['warmup_frames']=warmup_frames;data['runner_source']=Path(__file__).read_text();data['process_memory']={name:(out/(name+'-memory.txt')).read_text() for name in CAPTURES if (out/(name+'-memory.txt')).exists()};data['census']=captured_census
  part.write_text(json.dumps(data))
  journal.record(part,{},valid=False,reason='Stepped real-map preparation and memory diagnostic; requires matching captures, not cross-engine ranking, continuous-scroll p99 or whole-frame timing.')
 publish(journal.directory,repository)
